description: Find tracks inside your own collections by title, original title, creator, tag or the note on a collection item. Each result names the collections that hold the track. Returns at most 50 per page; cursor gives the next page. capped is true when the match list reached its limit, so a narrower query can find more.

cursor.description: Pass the cursor from the previous page.

query.description: Words to find. The last word also matches as a prefix.

name: search_collections
title: Find a track in your collections
